about_the_game:
This pack doesn’t unlock new levels, powers, or items - just your kindness. By purchasing this DLC, you’re directly supporting the developers and helping future updates come to life.

As a small thank you, you will have slime skins!

Nothing changes in gameplay. Everything changes in spirit.
